study: Pose-Consistent Visible-Surface Grounding, matched center/size and region-scale experiments
panel: Reuse exactly the 416 previously scored ordinary physical frames and all 832 decoded Qwen replies. Primary strata are Validation (288), split recording extension (128), and recording-separated relative to the original 96 development frames (224, including 96 of the Validation frames). This is an exposed mechanism test for the new algorithm.
full_factorial: Hold the original full four-scale winner fixed. P is the exact PCA completion. Rotate to Qwen yaw and cross original versus yaw-conditioned centers with original versus yaw-conditioned dimensions. The crossed endpoints are exact previous yaw-only and reanchored outputs. Extents and centers are substituted as components of precomputed hypotheses, with all frames retained. Report paired interaction and per-arm center and size error.
scales: Keep original Qwen window, dimensions, terrain, frozen 16384 point sampling, fit pixel cells, visibility evidence, fallback and measured-box/PCA completion. Compare four nested scales with each isolated existing level (indices 0,2,5,7), ordinary Euclidean radius components at the same per-frame radius as level index 5, and PCA on the foreground sample inside the entire Qwen window. Minimum 8 points for all supports, 5 original central fit pixels, original region-to-window score for all cluster arms. Report overall and jointly eligible, with no scale selected by labels.
ray_protocol: Use the original 4x4 checkerboard: the even bit remains the fit half. Of the odd cells, the second bit gives selection and audit. Both reserved sets are removed at source draw index before constructing the fit tree or terrain, also conservatively removing held cells in model-coordinate projection. Only use raw nearest-per-cell returns in the full Qwen window attached to the selected fit node with the original nearest-point and cut rule. Both pose candidates use the same node and rays. The audit cell depths never determine the fit, orientation selection, candidate fallback or eligibility for selection. Camera-to-return first-slab optical depth is a camera-centered visibility test, not a claim about the original LiDAR beam origin. Audit also reports a post-seal GT-supported ray subset.
selector: At least five selection rays; output the hypothesis of lower mean min(1, absolute first-face depth residual / max(0.1 m, half Qwen short horizontal side)). A miss receives unit cost. Ties retain PCA. Compare exact original anchoring with per-pose observed extent floors (F pair) and a second mutually controlled pair with Qwen dimensions fixed at both yaws and camera-facing slab anchoring (C pair). Matched PCA and Qwen fixed controls may use the same fit and selection budget; they never use audit ranges. Strict fallbacks use original Qwen median if no fit node. Report both strict selectors, all fixed controls, and post-seal two-candidate task ceilings.
full_transfer: For a practical full-scan comparison, transfer the F selector's Qwen-vs-PCA decision to the unchanged full winner if its central fitting-bin set and the blind-fit winner's set have Jaccard at least 0.5 and selection is supported. Each output is the exact full P or full jointly reanchored Q. This task-only arm uses the full support, so no audit-ray residual is used to evaluate it as a held-out geometry estimate.
primary_readouts: Acc@25, Acc@50 strict >, mIoU, center/extent error, paired rescues and harms, recorded strata, two oriented-IoU implementations, and independent label-free audit residuals and misses. Primary reference is the prior locked full PCA; for selector mechanism compare matched held-fit PCA, always-Q, and post-seal oracle. Retain the original candidate unless the new selector improves on Quad without systematic Waymo and Drone regression and beats the comparable locked full task baseline. No thresholds fit to the panel.
